operator.organizationsCardDescription: Every organization on the platform and its withdrawable balance.
operator.totalsDescription: Accumulated platform revenue and what the platform currently owes, in {currency}.
operator.keptFeeNote: Includes {amount} in fees and fee IVA kept on reversed sales.
operator.organizationsDescription: Every organization on the platform, its events, and its withdrawable balance.
operator.organizationsPageSummary: Page {page} of {pages} · {total, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}}
operator.balancesDescription: Net proceeds from this organization's online sales, less what has already been paid out — in full, and the part of it that has cleared.
operator.balanceNegative: Negative: this organization owes the platform after a post-settlement reversal.
operator.payableBelowWithdrawable: What this organization may ask for today. The rest is sales recorded today, or with a reversal still open, which have not cleared.
operator.payableAllCleared: Every sale behind this balance has cleared.
operator.houseDescription: An organization the platform's own entity runs. Every paid online sale of its events is the platform's own sale, invoiced to the buyer by the platform's issuer. Designating does not depend on the issuer: it goes through with no issuer, a test issuer or an expired certificate, and it affects future sales only.
operator.houseFailed: Could not change the house designation.
operator.houseCurrencyBlocked: This organization trades in {currency}. Only an organization trading in USD can be a house organization.
operator.recordPayoutDescription: Record money that has already left the bank. Current balance: <value>{balance}</value>.
operator.outstandingAlertTitle: This organization is already waiting on a payout request
operator.outstandingAlertBody: {organization} asked for <value>{amount}</value> on {date}. Fulfilling the request records the payout and answers the ask in one step. Recording here leaves the request open, and risks paying twice.
operator.amountNotPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
operator.paidAtRequired: Choose the date the money left the bank
operator.eventsDescription: Every Event this organization runs, newest first.
operator.questionsLoadFailedTitle: Could not load the ticket questions
operator.questionsDescription: Everything this organization asks of whoever holds a ticket to this event, by ticket type. Revoking an approved question retires it: it is asked of nobody from that moment, the answers already given stay, and every org admin is emailed the reason.
operator.questionsPerTicketType: What holders of this ticket type are asked.
operator.revokeReasonDescription: Sent to every org admin of the organization, word for word, and shown beside the question in their editor.
operator.revokeReasonPlaceholder: This asks for health information, which the platform does not collect.
operator.revokeReasonRequired: Give a reason — the organization is shown this
operator.revokeDialogBody: "{label}" will stop being asked immediately. Answers already given stay on their tickets and in the export. Every org admin of {organization} will receive this reason:
operator.payoutHistoryDescription: Every Payout recorded against this organization, newest first.
operator.organizationRequestsDescription: Every payout this organization has asked for, newest first.
operator.organizationRequestsEmpty: This organization has never asked to be paid.
operator.confirmOutstandingTitle: This organization is waiting on a payout request
operator.confirmOutstandingBody: {organization} has an outstanding request for <value>{requested}</value>, asked for on {date} by {who}. Recording {amount} here does not answer it — the request stays open, and another operator may still fulfil it. Only record directly if this is a different transfer.
operator.confirmExceedsBody: You are recording {amount} against a balance of {balance}. This is accepted and will leave {organization} with a negative balance. Record it only if the money really moved.
operator.queueLoadFailed: Could not load the payout requests.
operator.queueDescription: Every organization waiting to be paid, longest wait first. A transfer nobody has confirmed in three days is flagged.
operator.queueWaitingDescription: Every outstanding request across every organization — the ones nobody has answered and the ones whose transfer has been submitted but not yet confirmed. Account numbers are shown in part here; open a request to see the full bank details and pay it.
operator.queueEmpty: Nobody is waiting to be paid.
operator.transferStale: Unconfirmed for over 72 hours — check the transfer.
operator.queueTransferSent: {days, plural, =0 {Sent today by {who}} one {Sent # day ago by {who}} other {Sent # days ago by {who}}}
operator.queuePageSummary: Page {page} of {pages} · {total, plural, one {# request waiting} other {# requests waiting}}
operator.requestHeaderWaiting: Asked for by {who} · {days, plural, =0 {asked today} one {waiting # day} other {waiting # days}}
operator.askDescription: What this organization asked for, and what it could have asked for at the time.
operator.askAbovePayableNow: More than this organization can ask for today ({payable} has cleared). The request was within its balance when it was made and nothing re-checks it — paying it is your call.
operator.askWithinCleared: Within what has cleared today. Withdrawable balance in full: {balance}.
operator.transferAgeWithReference: {days, plural, =0 {Sent today} one {Sent # day ago} other {Sent # days ago}} · bank reference {reference}
operator.transferAgeNoReference: {days, plural, =0 {Sent today} one {Sent # day ago} other {Sent # days ago}} · the bank gave no reference
operator.transferStaleDetail: Nobody has confirmed this for over 72 hours. A transfer normally lands within 48. Check it with the bank, then either record the payout or mark it failed.
operator.transferWaitingOnBank: Waiting on the bank. A transfer can take up to 48 hours to land.
operator.whereToPayDescription: The bank details as this request recorded them. A later change to the organization's payout profile does not touch them — this is the account the platform was told to pay.
operator.requestOrganizationDescription: Who is being paid, and everything else about their money.
operator.answerDescriptionProcessing: The transfer is out there and the bank has not confirmed it. Record the payout when the money lands, or mark it failed when it comes back.
operator.answerDescriptionPending: Transfer the money to the account above first. If it settled, record it here and the request is marked paid in the same action. If it will take a day or two, mark it processing instead — that records the transfer without touching the ledger.
operator.fulfilAmountRequired: Enter the amount that actually left the bank.
operator.fulfilmentShort: {amount} less than was asked for. The request will be marked paid for what you record, and the organization can ask again for the rest.
operator.fulfilmentOver: {amount} more than was asked for. The request will be marked paid, and the difference stays visible on it.
operator.fulfilled: Payout of {amount} recorded, and the request is marked paid
operator.exceedsDialogTitle: More than this organization is owed
operator.exceedsDialogBody: You are recording {amount} against a withdrawable balance of {balance}. That is accepted — the money has already left the bank — and the balance will go negative to say so.
operator.transferReferenceLabel: Or mark it processing — bank reference (optional)
operator.transferReferenceDescription: Use this when you have sent the transfer but the bank has not confirmed it. No payout is recorded yet, and the request stays in the queue.
operator.markedProcessing: Marked as processing — no payout recorded until the money lands
operator.markProcessingFailed: Could not mark the request processing.
operator.processingDialogTitle: You have already sent this transfer?
operator.processingDialogBody: Only press this if the money has left the bank. {organization} will see that their transfer is on its way and will no longer be able to cancel the request. NO PAYOUT IS RECORDED yet — come back and record it when the money lands, or mark it failed if the bank sends it back.
operator.processingDialogNoReference: No bank reference — that is fine, PayPhone does not always give one.
operator.processingDialogConfirm: Yes, it is on its way
operator.failureReasonLabel: Or the transfer bounced — what did the bank say?
operator.failureReasonDescription: The organization is shown this, and it is what they act on. A wrong account number is the usual cause, and they fix it on their payout profile before asking again.
operator.failureReasonPlaceholder: Banco Pichincha returned it: the account number does not exist.
operator.failureReasonRequired: Say what the bank said. The organization is shown this, and it is what they act on.
operator.markedFailed: Marked as failed — the organization is told why
operator.markFailedFailed: Could not mark the transfer failed.
operator.failureDialogTitle: The bank sent this transfer back?
operator.failureDialogBody: {organization} will see this on their payouts page as a failed transfer — not as a refusal — and will be pointed at their payout profile to correct it. This request cannot be reopened; they submit a new one. Nothing is undone in the ledger, because marking it processing recorded no payout.
operator.declineReasonDescription: The organization is shown this, and is free to ask again.
operator.declineReasonPlaceholder: Your event is three months out — ask again once the doors have opened.
operator.declineReasonRequired: Say why. The organization is shown this.
operator.declineDialogBody: {organization} will see this reason on their payouts page, and may submit a new request straight away. Declining is final — this request cannot be reopened.
operator.saleLookupDescription: Look a ticket sale up by its sale confirmation reference, across every organization.
operator.saleNotFoundBody: Nothing on the platform carries the sale confirmation reference <ref>{reference}</ref>. Check it against the confirmation email — the reference looks like <ref>TP-…</ref>.
operator.reversalWindowDescription: The period in which the buyer could undo this sale themselves: until 20:00 Ecuador time on the day of purchase, or the event's start, whichever comes first.
operator.reversalWindowNever: This sale never had a reversal window
operator.amountsDescription: What the buyer paid and how it was split, as this sale snapshotted it at the time.
operator.memoDescription: What the operator asserted when they recorded this reversal. Visible to platform operators only — the organization sees the sale as reversed by the platform and nothing of this.
operator.reverseDescriptionFree: This sale collected nothing, so there is no refund to record and no fee to decide. Reversing it voids the tickets, puts them back on sale and emails the buyer.
operator.reverseDescriptionPaid: Use this after you have already refunded the buyer yourself — in the payment provider's dashboard, or by bank transfer. It records what happened: no payment provider is called from here, and nothing is refunded by submitting this form.
operator.refundedHint: What actually left our account. This sale collected {amount}, which is the most it can be.
operator.refundedRequired: Enter the amount the buyer got back.
operator.feeKeptRequired: Say whether the platform kept its fee.
operator.feeKeptOption: Kept — the platform keeps {amount} (fee and fee IVA)
operator.feeReturnedOption: Returned — the platform keeps nothing on this sale
operator.reversalNotePlaceholder: Refunded via the PayPhone dashboard; bank transfer, fee waived as goodwill; ...
operator.reverseDialogBody: This cannot be undone. There is no un-reversal: the tickets go back on sale immediately and the void email cannot be unsent.
operator.reverseDialogTickets: {count, plural, one {# ticket returns} other {# tickets return}} to {event}, on sale again at once.
operator.reverseDialogBalance: {organization}'s withdrawable balance drops by {amount}, going negative if this sale was already paid out.
operator.reverseDialogEmail: {email} is emailed that their tickets are no longer valid, quoting {reference}.
operator.reverseDialogNoMoney: No money is recorded: this sale collected nothing, so there was nothing to refund and no fee to keep. No payment provider is called.
operator.reverseDialogMoneyKept: You are recording that {amount} already went back to the buyer, and that the platform keeps its fee. No payment provider is called.
operator.reverseDialogMoneyReturned: You are recording that {amount} already went back to the buyer, and that the platform returns its fee. No payment provider is called.
operator.reAddressDescription: Use this when the buyer typed their email address wrong and cannot reach their tickets. Enter the address they meant: we email it a link, and nothing moves until they accept. The sale stays with the address it was sold to in the meantime, and no payment provider is called.
operator.reAddressEmailRequired: Enter the address the buyer meant.
operator.reAddressEmailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
operator.reAddressEmailSame: That is already the address this sale is addressed to.
operator.reAddressNotePlaceholder: Buyer wrote in from the support address; organizer forwarded the reference; ...
operator.saleReAddressed: Re-addressing recorded — the corrected address has been emailed
operator.reAddressPendingDescription: The corrected address has been emailed a link. Nothing moves until they accept it: the sale still belongs to the address it was sold to, and the wrong address has not been told anything.
operator.reAddressHistoryDescription: Every re-addressing of this sale that was accepted: the address it was sold to, the address it moved to, who recorded it and when. Kept permanently, whatever has happened to the sale since.
operator.reAddressPendingActions: Send again emails the same address a fresh link and cancels the earlier one. Withdraw cancels the link: nobody is emailed and the sale stays where it is; you can then re-address it afresh.
operator.reAddressResent: A fresh link was emailed to the corrected address
operator.reAddressResendFailed: Could not send the email again.
operator.reAddressWithdrawn: Re-addressing withdrawn: the link no longer works
operator.buyerDescription: The customer as this sale recorded them.
operator.eventAndOrganizationDescription: Whose sale this is, and what it is for.
operator.invoicingIssuerDescription: The platform's own registration with the SRI. Every factura the platform issues carries these details.
operator.invoicingIssuerNoneYet: No issuer has been recorded yet. Fill in the details from the platform's RUC certificate and save.
operator.invoicingEnvironmentDescription: Certify against the test environment first and switch to production once it works. You can switch back at any time; every factura records the environment it was issued under.
operator.invoicingDetailsDescription: As registered with the SRI. The field names are the SRI's own.
operator.invoicingNombreComercialHint: Optional. Leave empty if the platform trades under its legal name.
operator.invoicingPuntoEmisionLabel: Point of emission code (punto de emisión)
operator.invoicingThreeDigitsHint: Three digits, as printed in the factura number (001-001-000000001).
operator.invoicingObligadoContabilidadLabel: Obliged to keep accounting records (obligado a llevar contabilidad)
operator.invoicingAgenteRetencionHint: Optional. The resolution number if the platform is a withholding agent; leave empty if it is not.
operator.invoicingCertificateDescription: The platform's .p12 file, kept encrypted on the server. Every factura is signed with it. Uploading again replaces the certificate outright.
operator.invoicingCertificateNone: No certificate has been uploaded. The issuer cannot sign facturas until one is.
operator.invoicingCertificateNeedsIssuer: Save the issuer details before uploading a certificate.
operator.invoicingCertificateMismatchTitle: The certificate's RUC does not match the issuer's
operator.invoicingCertificateMismatch: The certificate names RUC {certificateRuc}; the issuer is recorded under {issuerRuc}. The SRI may reject facturas signed with it. Check which one is right before issuing.
operator.invoicingCertificateExpiringTitle: The signing certificate is about to expire
operator.invoicingCertificateExpiring: The signing certificate expires on {date} ({days, plural, =0 {today} one {in # day} other {in # days}}). Upload a current .p12 before then, or every Sale Invoice will park unsigned.
operator.invoicingCertificateExpired: The signing certificate expired on {date}. Sale Invoices are parking unsigned until a current .p12 is uploaded.
operator.invoicingCertificateExpiryOpenIssuer: Open the Issuer page to upload a current certificate.
operator.invoicingCertificateFileHint: The signing certificate as your certification authority delivered it (.p12 or .pfx).
operator.invoicingCertificatePasswordHint: Checked when the file is opened. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
operator.invoicingListDescription: Every factura the platform has issued to the SRI, newest first.
operator.invoicingListLoadFailedTitle: Could not load the Tax Invoices
operator.invoicingListLoadFailed: Could not load the Tax Invoices.
operator.invoicingListEmpty: No Tax Invoices have been issued yet.
operator.invoicingDetailPricedAt: Priced with IVA inside the price at {rate}.
operator.invoicingDetailReissueReason: Reason: Sale Invoice Reissue — the recipient's details were corrected; the sale was not reversed.
operator.invoicingAuthorizationNotIssued: This document has not been issued yet: no number, no clave de acceso, and nothing sent to the SRI. The platform issues it on its own.
operator.invoicingNewDescription: Issue a factura to the SRI. The next number is used only when you press Issue.
operator.invoicingNotReadyTitle: The issuer is not ready to issue
operator.invoicingNotReadyNoIssuer: No issuer has been recorded. Record the platform's SRI details before issuing.
operator.invoicingNotReadyNoCertificate: The issuer has no signing certificate. Upload the .p12 before issuing.
operator.invoicingRecipientDescription: Who the factura is issued to. There is no consumidor final: every factura can later be credited or annulled.
operator.invoicingRecipientEmailHint: Placed in the factura's additional information automatically, as the SRI convention expects.
operator.invoicingEmissionDateHint: Today in Ecuador, fixed by the SRI. It cannot be changed.
operator.invoicingAdditionalDescription: Up to 14 extra name/value pairs. The Recipient's email takes the fifteenth automatically.
operator.invoicingTotalsComputed: Computed by the server; these are the numbers stored on the factura.
operator.invoicingTotalsUnavailable: Add a valid line to see the totals.
operator.invoicingIssueFailedTitle: The Tax Invoice was not issued
operator.invoicingIssueFailed: Could not issue the Tax Invoice.
operator.invoicingDetailLoadFailedTitle: Could not load the Tax Invoice
operator.invoicingDetailLoadFailed: Could not load the Tax Invoice.
operator.invoicingActionsDescription: The SRI has not authorized this Tax Invoice. Check status asks the SRI again without sending anything; Resend sends the same document under the same clave de acceso and number, re-signed with the current certificate.
operator.invoicingCheckStatusHint: It was received and is still being processed. Check status rather than resending it.
operator.invoicingResendHintTitle: The SRI has no record of this document
operator.invoicingResendHint: It was never received. Resend it.
operator.invoicingCheckedAuthorized: The SRI authorized the Tax Invoice.
operator.invoicingCheckedNotAuthorized: The SRI did not authorize the Tax Invoice. See its messages.
operator.invoicingCheckedRejected: The SRI returned the Tax Invoice. See its messages.
operator.invoicingCheckedPending: The SRI has not decided yet. The Tax Invoice stays pending.
operator.invoicingCheckFailed: The status could not be checked.
operator.invoicingResendFailed: The Tax Invoice could not be resent.
operator.attentionCardDescription: Sale Invoices and Credit Notes the SRI refused, left unanswered, or that could not be signed, across the platform, longest wait first.
operator.recipientWarningCardDescription: Authorized Sale Invoices the SRI warned about: the Recipient's Tax ID does not exist or is incorrect. The document stands; the buyer's factura may be in the wrong name.
operator.invoicingRecipientWarningFilter: Only documents with a Recipient warning ({count})
operator.invoicingListEmptyForRecipientWarning: No document carries a Recipient warning.
operator.invoicingRecipientWarningTitle: The SRI warned about the Recipient
operator.invoicingRecipientWarningBody: The SRI authorized this document but said the Recipient's Tax ID does not exist or is incorrect. The document is valid and stands; it may be declared to the wrong taxpayer. The warning stays until the document is superseded by a reissue.
operator.invoicingRecipientWarningNoQuote: The SRI's message is no longer among the stored messages.
operator.invoicingAttentionDescription: Every document parked for an operator, longest waiting first. Open one to check its status, resend it, or mark it annulled after annulling it at the SRI portal.
operator.invoicingAttentionLoadFailed: Could not load the documents that need attention.
operator.invoicingAttentionEmpty: No document needs attention. Every Sale Invoice and Credit Note is owed, pending, authorized or settled.
operator.invoicingMarkAnnulledHint: Only after annulling the document by hand at the SRI portal. The platform sends nothing to the SRI; it records that you did.
operator.invoicingMarkAnnulledConfirm: Do this only after annulling the document at the SRI portal. The record names you and the moment, the document keeps its number and XML, and nothing about it can be checked, resent or undone afterwards.
operator.invoicingMarkAnnulledFailed: The document could not be marked annulled.
operator.invoicingAnnulmentTrail: Marked annulled by {by} on {when}, after annulment at the SRI portal. The number and the signed XML are kept.
operator.invoicingReissueCardDescription: This Sale Invoice is authorized and current. If its recipient is wrong — a mistaken Tax ID, a name that is not the taxpayer's — reissue it: a Credit Note for the full amount is owed against it and a corrected Sale Invoice follows once the Credit Note is authorized. The sale, its tickets and the buyer's account are untouched.
operator.invoicingReissueDialogDescription: Correct only what is wrong. The Tax ID is validated as at checkout. The corrected factura keeps the lines, totals and IVA rate of this one and is mailed to the buyer once authorized; this one stays on file as superseded.
operator.invoicingReissueEmailHint: The address the sale carries now. It cannot be edited here: re-address the sale first if the buyer's email is wrong.
operator.invoicingReissueNoteHint: Optional, for whoever reads this chain later. Shown to operators only, never mailed. At most 500 characters.
operator.invoicingReissueDone: The reissue is recorded. The Credit Note and the corrected Sale Invoice are owed and will be issued by the platform.
operator.invoicingReissueFailed: The Sale Invoice could not be reissued.
operator.invoicingDetailSupersededBy: Superseded by the corrected Sale Invoice
operator.invoicingReissueTrail: Reissued by {by} on {when}. The recipient's details were corrected; the sale was not reversed.
operator.saleDocumentsDescription: The Sale Invoice this sale owed, its Credit Note once reversed, and after a reissue the superseded Sale Invoice, its Credit Note and the corrected one, in that order. Each opens the document.
operator.saleDocumentsNone: This sale owes no tax document: its organization is not a House Organization.
operator.invoicingFrozenRuc: Read-only: Tax Invoices have been issued under this RUC, and it is part of every clave de acceso.
operator.invoicingFrozenNumbering: Read-only: a sequence has started under this establecimiento and punto de emisión, and numbering must stay continuous.
operator.invoicingDownloadsDescription: The signed XML exactly as sent to the SRI, and once the SRI authorizes the document, its authorization XML and the RIDE as a PDF. A manual Tax Invoice is not mailed by the platform: download and send them by hand.
operator.invoicingDownloadAuthorizationXmlUnavail: The authorization XML and the RIDE are available once the SRI authorizes the document.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedDescription: Every paid online sale of a House Organization that owes no Sale Invoice yet, oldest first. Select sales and invoice them to owe each one an ordinary Sale Invoice.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedTotal: {total, plural, =0 {No sales without a factura} one {# sale without a factura} other {# sales without a factura}}, oldest first.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedDatedTodayTitle: A factura issued from here is dated the day it is issued
operator.invoicingUninvoicedDatedTodayNotice: Not the day of the sale. The SRI does not accept a back-dated document; the sale's own date stays on the sale.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedLoadFailedTitle: Could not load the uninvoiced sales
operator.invoicingUninvoicedLoadFailed: We could not load the uninvoiced sales. Try again in a moment.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedUnavailable: Uninvoiced House Sales are listed only while Sale Invoicing is open. Nothing can be invoiced from here until it is.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedEmpty: The backlog is clear: every paid online sale of a House Organization has its Sale Invoice.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedSelectAll: Select every sale on this page
operator.invoicingUninvoicedSelectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
operator.invoicingUninvoicedPageSummary: Page {page} of {pages} · {total, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}}
operator.invoicingUninvoicedConfirmBody: {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} for a total of {total}. Each one is owed an ordinary Sale Invoice, signed and submitted to the SRI by the platform.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedConfirmDatedToday: Each factura will be dated today, not the day of the sale.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedConfirmMail: Each buyer will receive the factura by email (XML and RIDE) once the SRI authorizes it.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedResultOwed: {count, plural, =0 {No sale was owed a Sale Invoice.} one {# sale is now owed a Sale Invoice.} other {# sales are now owed a Sale Invoice.}}
operator.invoicingUninvoicedResultRefused: {count, plural, one {# sale was refused:} other {# sales were refused:}}
operator.invoicingUninvoicedRefusedNotACandidate: already invoiced or no longer a candidate
operator.invoicingUninvoicedRefusedUnsupported: the platform cannot invoice this sale as transacted
operator.invoicingUninvoicedBackfillFailedTitle: The sales could not be invoiced
operator.invoicingUninvoicedBackfillFailed: Nothing was invoiced. Try again in a moment.
operator.invoicingUninvoicedBackfillUnavailable: Sale invoicing is switched off right now, so nothing was invoiced.
operator.invoicingBackfillTrail: Owed by {by} on {when} (Sale Invoice Backfill). The document was not born at checkout: it was issued for a past sale, and dated the day it was issued.

legal.title: Legal center
legal.description: The platform's own agreements: the privacy policy and the terms and conditions. One draft per document, saved here rather than in your browser.
legal.loadFailedTitle: Could not load the legal center
legal.loadFailed: Could not load the legal center.
legal.publishedSummary: Edition {label}, in effect since {date}. This is what people are reading and what acceptances point at.
legal.draftNeverSaved: No draft saved yet. What you see is a copy of the published edition.
legal.unsavedChanges: You have changes that are not saved yet.
legal.baseStaleTitle: A new edition was published while this draft sat
legal.baseStale: This draft was started from an older edition. Check it against what is published now before publishing.
legal.scheduledGating: On that day everyone will be asked to accept again — every customer, and everyone on the staff platform. Until then nothing has changed for anyone, and you can still take it back.
legal.scheduledCorrection: It takes effect with the edition it corrects, and asks nobody to accept anything again.
legal.scheduledCancelHint: Takes effect at once. The edition is kept on the record and its number is not reused.
legal.scheduledCancelFailed: The edition could not be cancelled.
legal.languagesHint: The languages this draft will publish in. A language you keep must be complete; a language you drop stops being published at all.
legal.noLanguages: A draft must publish in at least one language.
legal.plainText: These boxes are markdown, not a rich-text editor. A line you break becomes a line break on the published page, and raw HTML is dropped without a word. Write one line per block, the way the text is already written.
legal.surfaceShortNotice: Shown above the checkout consent boxes.
legal.surfaceMarketingConsent: An optional checkbox at sign-up and at checkout.
legal.surfaceNetworkingConsent: An optional checkbox at sign-up and at checkout.
legal.surfaceTermsAcceptance: The checkbox at sign-up, and before a staff session.
legal.surfaceUnknown: Nothing on the platform renders this yet.
legal.addHint: A new consent box needs its label here before anything can ask for it. It is added at the end; move it to where it belongs.
legal.addRefused: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, and a slug this draft does not already have.
legal.complete: Every artifact is written in every language this draft publishes.
legal.incomplete: {n} cells are still empty. A draft cannot be published with a hole in it.
legal.structural: This draft adds or removes an artifact, so it is a new edition rather than a correction.
legal.sameAsPublished: This draft says exactly what is published today.
legal.discardConfirm: The draft is deleted and the editor starts again from the published edition. Nothing anybody has read or accepted changes.
legal.previewDescription: In {locale}, rendered exactly as a reader sees it. The page around it is not shown; the words are.
legal.previewEmpty: There is nothing written here to preview.
legal.previewSaveFirst: Save the draft first: a preview shows the text that will be published.
legal.reviewSaveFirst: Save the draft to preview it and to see what it changes.
legal.reviewHint: Publishing will require that every artifact has been previewed and that this diff has been seen. Editing text undoes both for the text you changed.
legal.reviewPreviewedAll: Every artifact has been previewed in every language this draft publishes.
legal.reviewPreviewedSome: {n} artifacts previewed, {left} still to look at.
legal.reviewDiffSeen: You have seen what this draft changes.
legal.reviewDiffNotSeen: You have not seen what this draft changes yet.
legal.protectedLocalePolicy: Spanish cannot be unpublished. The Ley Orgánica de Protección de Datos Personales requires this notice to be given in Spanish.
legal.protectedLocaleTerms: Spanish cannot be unpublished. The Spanish text is the contract (§37); the English one is a translation of it.
legal.publishHint: A new edition asks everybody to accept again. A correction fixes the words and asks nobody.
legal.publishBlocked: Save the draft, fill every language, preview every artifact and look at what changes before publishing.
legal.effectiveDateHint: Midnight in Ecuador, on the day you choose. The earliest is {date}: a new edition waits a night, so you can change your mind.
legal.publishEditionConsequence: {n} people will be asked to accept again.
legal.publishConfirmBody: It takes effect on {date}, and from that day {n} people are asked to accept again. Nothing that has already been accepted is changed, and nobody is signed out.
legal.publishCorrectionLink: Publish as correction {label} instead — this asks nobody to accept again
legal.correctionRefusedStructural: A correction cannot add or remove an artifact
legal.correctionRefusedLocales: A correction cannot change which languages the document is published in
legal.correctionRefusedEmpty: This draft says exactly what is published, so there is nothing to correct
legal.correctionConfirmBody: It takes effect at once and asks nobody to accept again. The edition it corrects keeps its own text, exactly as the people who accepted it saw it.
legal.correctionReasonHint: One sentence, kept on the record. The comparison already shows what moved; this says what it was for.
legal.diffHint: Against the edition published now, one artifact and one language at a time.
legal.diffFailed: Could not record that the diff was seen.
legal.diffNoChanges: This draft says exactly what is published today.
legal.diffMissingCells: {n} cells are empty. A draft cannot be published with a hole in it.

legalAcceptances.customersDescription: Who has accepted the current privacy policy and terms, and who still owes an acceptance.
legalAcceptances.staffDescription: Who on the staff platform has accepted the current terms. Everyone signs in as an organizer, so the terms are the only staff gate.
legalAcceptances.filtersDescription: Pick a document and a state. Outstanding is people who accepted an earlier edition and owe a fresh acceptance.
legalAcceptances.staffFiltersDescription: Pick a state. Outstanding is people who accepted an earlier edition and owe a fresh acceptance.
legalAcceptances.pageDescription: Fifty at a time, oldest address first. There is no total and no export.

legalRecords.customerDescription: Everything this person did, as it was recorded. Read one person at a time.
legalRecords.staffDescription: Every edition of the terms this person accepted in order to sign in.
legalRecords.subjectNotFound: There is no consent record for that person. The link may come from an older list.
legalRecords.staffSubjectNotFound: There is no acceptance record for that person. The link may come from an older list, or have been made under a different key.
legalRecords.crossLinkTitle: The same person on the staff platform
legalRecords.crossLinkToStaff: This address also signs in to the staff platform. The two records are separate, and neither is a summary of the other.
legalRecords.crossLinkToCustomerAction: Open their consent record as a customer
legalRecords.historyComplete: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing recorded.} one {One act, and this is the whole record.} other {# acts, and this is the whole record.}}
legalRecords.historyTruncated: {count, plural, one {One act so far} other {# acts so far}}, {pageSize} at a time. There is more to read.
legalRecords.historyEmpty: Nothing has been recorded for this person.
legalRecords.staffHistoryComplete: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing recorded.} one {One acceptance, and this is the whole record.} other {# acceptances, and this is the whole record.}}
legalRecords.staffHistoryEmpty: This person has never accepted the terms.
legalRecords.channel_account_settings: Changed a setting in their account
legalRecords.consentPendingConfirmation: Pending confirmation — ticked by somebody who never proved the address
legalRecords.consentWithdrawDescription: Only what the artefact actually asks for. This surface can withdraw a consent and can never grant one — the API refuses a grant, not just this form. Neither the terms nor privacy policy acceptance can be withdrawn.
legalRecords.consentNothingNamed: Say which consent the form withdraws.
legalRecords.consentArtefactPlaceholder: Formulario de Revocatoria, signed 2026-08-01, received by post 2026-08-05
legalRecords.consentArtefactRequired: Name the form, letter or email this withdrawal answers.
legalRecords.consentArtefactHint: Required. Name the form, letter or email you are holding, so the record points at the paper. The paper itself is not stored here.
legalRecords.consentWithdrawalRecorded: Withdrawal recorded. The customer has been emailed a confirmation.
legalRecords.consentWithdrawalNoChange: Withdrawal recorded. Nothing changed, so no confirmation was emailed.
legalRecords.consentConfirmBody: You are recording it on {email}'s behalf. Your email address is stored on the record, alongside the artefact you named.
legalRecords.consentConfirmMarketing: Marketing consent is withdrawn. Campaign email stops, including the weekly follow digest.
legalRecords.consentConfirmNetworking: Networking consent is withdrawn. Their profile stops being shown to attendees.
legalRecords.consentConfirmContinues: Their account, tickets, receipts, passcodes and reversal notices all continue. This is not a deletion, and they can turn either consent back on themselves.
legalRecords.consentConfirmEmail: They are emailed a confirmation, in their own language — but only if this actually takes something away.
legalRecords.packDescription: One file that answers a data subject or a regulator: everything held about this address, in both halves of the platform, with the exact legal text behind every act. Generated when you ask for it and never stored.
legalRecords.packSpansBoth: It covers this address in both populations — as a customer and on the staff platform — so a person who is both gets one file, and the same file whichever record you generate it from.
legalRecords.packNeverStored: Nothing is kept but the file's SHA-256, its size and the ids of the acts it covered. The pack is rebuilt byte for byte from the same acts whenever it is asked for again.
legalRecords.packOperatorOnly: There is no self-service download. Send this to the person yourself.
legalRecords.packFailed: Could not generate the evidence pack.

legalAccessLog.title: Access log
legalAccessLog.description: Every read of somebody's consent data by this platform: who looked, at what, and when. Reading this page is itself recorded.
legalAccessLog.filtersDescription: Filter by operator, act and date. There is deliberately no way to search by the person an act was about: this log must not become a second way to look people up.
legalAccessLog.pageDescription: Fifty at a time, newest first.
legalAccessLog.loadFailedTitle: The log could not be loaded
legalAccessLog.retentionNote: Nothing here is ever deleted and there is no export: the log is read where it lives.

envelope.LEGAL_STANDING_NOT_AVAILABLE: That acceptance state doesn't apply to these people.
envelope.STAFF_DIGEST_UNAVAILABLE: This screen is unavailable because this deployment has no link secret configured.
envelope.LEGAL_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: There is no consent record for that person.
envelope.STAFF_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: There is no acceptance record for that person.
envelope.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
envelope.INVALID_JSON: We couldn't read what your browser sent. Please try again.
envelope.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the details above and try again.
envelope.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
envelope.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: You're not signed in. Sign in to continue.
envelope.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
envelope.OTP_RATE_LIMITED: Too many passcode requests. Please try again later.
envelope.OTP_GLOBAL_CEILING_REACHED: Passcode sending is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
envelope.OTP_EXPIRED: That passcode has expired. Request a new one.
envelope.OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED: Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new passcode.
envelope.GOOGLE_SIGN_IN_FAILED: We couldn't finish signing you in with Google. Try again, or use a passcode.
envelope.IMPORT_FILE_INVALID: We couldn't read that file. Use the template and upload a .csv or .xlsx.
envelope.IMPORT_FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large to import. Split it into smaller files and import them one at a time.
envelope.IMPORT_BATCH_FAILED: The import couldn't be recorded. Review the preview and try again.
envelope.IMPORT_NOT_LATEST_BATCH: Only the most recent import can be undone.
envelope.IMPORT_ALREADY_REVERSED: That import has already been undone.
envelope.INVALID_IMPORT_SOURCE: That isn't a source we can import from.
envelope.EVENT_SLUG_TAKEN: Another event in this organization already uses that slug.
envelope.EVENT_NOT_DRAFT: That can only be changed while the event is a draft.
envelope.EVENT_NOT_PUBLISHED: Only a published event can be listed on the storefront.
envelope.EVENT_DELETE_FORBIDDEN: Only a draft event can be deleted.
envelope.EVENT_PUBLISH_REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET: This event is missing details it needs before it can be published.
envelope.EVENT_REGISTRATION_MODE_LOCKED: How an event takes sign-ups is settled when it is published and cannot change afterwards. Create a new event instead.
envelope.EVENT_REGISTRATION_URL_REQUIRED: A published event that registers elsewhere must keep its registration link: it is the only way in. Replace it rather than removing it.
envelope.EVENT_IS_EXTERNAL_REGISTRATION: This event registers elsewhere and does not sell tickets. Switch it back to selling tickets first.
envelope.EVENT_HAS_TICKET_TYPES: This event cannot register elsewhere while it still has ticket types. Delete them first.
envelope.INVALID_REGISTRATION_URL: The registration link must be an https address.
envelope.COVER_UPLOAD_UNAVAILABLE: Cover image uploads are unavailable right now. Please try again later.
envelope.VIDEO_UPLOAD_UNAVAILABLE: Cover video uploads are unavailable right now. Please try again later.
envelope.COVER_VIDEO_REQUIRES_COVER_IMAGE: A cover video needs a cover image as its poster: add the image first, and remove the video before removing the image.
envelope.INVALID_IMAGE_CONTENT_TYPE: That image format isn't supported. Use JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
envelope.INVALID_VIDEO_CONTENT_TYPE: That video format isn't supported. Use MP4.
envelope.TICKET_TYPE_NOT_FOUND: That ticket type no longer exists.
envelope.TICKET_TYPE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN: A ticket type can only be deleted while the event is a draft.
envelope.CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: There is not enough capacity left on that ticket type.
envelope.PROMOTIONAL_PRICE_NOT_BELOW_LIST_PRICE: The promotional price must be below the list price. Lower it, or raise the list price first.
envelope.PROMOTION_ALREADY_EXISTS: This ticket type already has a promotion. Reload the section to edit the existing one.
envelope.PROMOTION_NOT_FOUND: This ticket type no longer has a promotion. Reload the section and set a new one.
envelope.LIST_PRICE_NOT_ABOVE_PROMOTIONAL_PRICE: The list price must stay above the promotional price. Adjust or remove the promotion first.
envelope.INVALID_TAG: A tag is 1 to 30 characters, using only letters, numbers, spaces, and hyphens.
envelope.TOO_MANY_TAGS: An event can carry at most {max} tags.
envelope.AFFILIATE_LINK_NOT_FOUND: That affiliate link no longer exists.
envelope.AFFILIATE_LINK_HAS_HISTORY: This affiliate link has clicks or attributed sales, so it can no longer be deleted. Deactivate it instead and it keeps its history.
envelope.AFFILIATE_LINK_CODE_EXHAUSTED: We couldn't generate a code for that affiliate link. Please try again.
envelope.PAYOUT_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: That payout request no longer exists.
envelope.PAYOUT_REQUEST_NOT_PENDING: This payout request can no longer be cancelled. Reload the page to see where it got to.
envelope.PAYOUT_REQUEST_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE_BALANCE: You can only request up to your Payable Balance.
envelope.PAYOUT_REQUEST_ALREADY_RESOLVED: This payout request was already answered by {resolved_by}, and nothing was recorded here. If you also transferred the money, record the payout directly against the organization — otherwise the books will understate what left the account.
envelope.PAYOUT_REQUEST_TRANSFER_ALREADY_SUBMITTE: The transfer for this payout request was already submitted by {transfer_submitted_by} and is being processed. Wait for the bank to confirm it — then record the payout that answers it.
envelope.PAYOUT_REQUEST_TRANSFER_NOT_SUBMITTED: No transfer has been submitted for this payout request, so there is none to have failed. Mark it processing once you submit one — or decline it, if the answer is no.
envelope.SALE_ALREADY_REVERSED: This sale has already been reversed.
envelope.SALE_NOT_IMPORTED: Only an imported sale can be reversed here. An online sale is reversed by the buyer within the Reversal Window, or by the platform.
envelope.SALE_NOT_REVERSIBLE: Only an Online Sale can be reversed here — no money for this sale passed through the platform. An imported sale is undone through its Sale Import.
envelope.SALE_REVERSAL_IN_PROGRESS: A reversal of this sale is already being processed. Try again in a moment.
envelope.REFUNDED_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_COLLECTED: The refunded amount is more than this sale collected.
envelope.REFUNDED_AMOUNT_REQUIRED: This sale collected money. State what the buyer got back and whether the platform kept its fee.
envelope.NOTHING_TO_REFUND: This sale collected nothing, so there was nothing to refund. Record the reversal without a refunded amount or a fee decision.
envelope.SALE_NOT_RE_ADDRESSABLE: Only an online sale can be re-addressed. An imported sale is corrected through its sale import.
envelope.RE_ADDRESSING_EVENT_STARTED: This sale's event has already started, so it can no longer be re-addressed.
envelope.RE_ADDRESSING_SAME_ADDRESS: That is already the address this sale is addressed to.
envelope.RE_ADDRESSING_NOTHING_PENDING: No re-addressing of this sale is pending. Reload the page to see where it stands.
envelope.ORGANIZATION_SLUG_TAKEN: Another organization already uses that slug. Choose a different one.
envelope.ORGANIZATION_DELETE_CONFIRMATION_MISMATC: That doesn't match the organization's name. Type it exactly as it is shown.
envelope.MEMBER_ALREADY_EXISTS: That email address is already a member of this organization.
envelope.LAST_ORG_ADMIN: An organization needs at least one Org Admin. Give the role to somebody else first.
envelope.CANNOT_REMOVE_SELF: You can't remove yourself. Add another Org Admin and have them remove you.
envelope.INVALID_MEMBER_ROLE: That isn't a role a member can hold.
envelope.ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND: That event assignment no longer exists.
envelope.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency can't change once this organization has ticket types.
envelope.HOUSE_ORGANIZATION_CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED: This organization trades in {currency}, and the platform issues Sale Invoices in USD only. A House Organization must trade in USD.
envelope.LOGO_UPLOAD_UNAVAILABLE: Logo uploads are unavailable right now. Please try again later.
envelope.INVALID_LOGO_IMAGE_KEY: That upload didn't finish. Choose the image again.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_KIND_FROZEN: Someone has already answered this question, so its answer type can no longer change. Retire it and add a new question instead.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_RETIRED: That question has been retired and can no longer be edited.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_APPROVED_IMMUTABLE: This question was approved as written, so only making it optional is allowed. Retire it and add a new question instead.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_OPTION_APPROVED_IMMUTABL: This option was approved as written and can't be renamed. Retire it and add a new option instead.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_UNDER_REVIEW: This question is under review and can't be edited until the review is withdrawn.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_OPTION_RETIRED: That option has been retired and can no longer be edited.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_KIND_TAKES_NO_OPTIONS: Only single choice and multiple choice questions have options.
envelope.TICKET_QUESTION_OPTIONS_REQUIRED: A choice question needs at least one option. Retire the whole question instead.
envelope.TOO_MANY_TICKET_QUESTION_OPTIONS: That question already has as many options as it can hold. Retire one to make room.
envelope.INVALID_TICKET_QUESTION_LABEL: Please write the question, and keep it within the length limit.
envelope.ANSWER_NOT_FOUND: There is no answer here to clear.
envelope.TICKET_SALE_REVERSED: This sale was reversed, so its answers can no longer be changed.
envelope.EVENT_STARTED_ANSWERS_CLOSED: This event has started, so its answers can no longer be changed.
envelope.ANSWER_OPTION_NOT_OFFERED: That option is not one this question offers.
envelope.ISSUER_NOT_FOUND: The Issuer has not been recorded yet. Save the Issuer details first.
envelope.CERTIFICATE_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server has no certificate key configured, so it cannot store a certificate. This is a deployment setting (INVOICING_CERTIFICATE_KEY), not a problem with the file or the password.
envelope.CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD_INCORRECT: The certificate could not be opened with that password. Nothing was changed.
envelope.CERTIFICATE_NO_RSA_KEY: That file has no RSA private key. The SRI requires an RSA signing certificate; nothing was changed.
envelope.CERTIFICATE_FILE_INVALID: That file is not a valid .p12 certificate. Nothing was changed.
envelope.INVOICE_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED: The Tax Invoice is already authorized. Nothing can be checked or resent for it.
envelope.INVOICE_NOT_ANNULLABLE: Only a document that is pending or needs attention can be marked annulled.
envelope.INVOICE_ANNULLED: The document has been marked annulled. Nothing can be checked or resent for it.
envelope.INVOICE_WITHDRAWN: The document was withdrawn: its sale was reversed before it was sent, and nothing was ever sent to the tax authority. Nothing can be checked or resent for it.
envelope.INVOICE_MANUAL_NOT_REISSUABLE: A manual Tax Invoice is not reissued. Issue another one by hand.
envelope.CREDIT_NOTE_NOT_REISSUABLE: A Credit Note cannot be reissued: only a Sale Invoice can.
envelope.INVOICE_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Only an authorized Sale Invoice can be reissued. Check its status, resend it or mark it annulled instead.
envelope.INVOICE_SALE_REVERSED: The sale was reversed. Its Sale Invoice is credited by the reversal and cannot be reissued.
envelope.REISSUE_IN_FLIGHT: A reissue of this sale's Sale Invoice is already in progress. Wait until its Credit Note and corrected Sale Invoice are authorized.
envelope.INVOICE_SUPERSEDED: This Sale Invoice was superseded by a reissue. Reissue the current Sale Invoice instead.
envelope.INVOICE_ALREADY_CREDITED: This Sale Invoice is already credited by an authorized Credit Note and cannot be credited again.
envelope.ISSUER_FIELD_FROZEN: That field can no longer change: documents have been issued under it.
envelope.SALE_INVOICING_UNAVAILABLE: Sale invoicing is switched off right now, so the Sale Invoice cannot be reissued.
